## Current position

### Postdoctoral Researcher in Urban Planning and Mobility

[GEMOTT (Research Group on Mobility, Transport and Territory)]{.cv-institution}\
[Department of Geography, Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona]{.cv-institution}\
[Barcelona, Spain · December 2024–present]{.cv-date}

- Researcher in the **ATRAPA** (*The Active Travel Backlash Paradox*) project.
- Spatial analysis of active-travel interventions and public response.
- Development and validation of spatial datasets.
- Collaborative research within GEMOTT.

## Previous employment

### Research Fellow in Active Travel and Road Safety Data Science

[Institute for Transport Studies, University of Leeds]{.cv-institution}\
[Leeds, United Kingdom · April 2022–March 2024]{.cv-date}

- Research on the **SATURN** and **CRUSE** projects in active travel and cycling planning.
- Road lighting, cycling demand modelling and spatial analysis.
- Co-supervision of MSc students.

### Postgraduate Researcher

[Leeds Institute for Data Analytics, University of Leeds]{.cv-institution}\
[Leeds, United Kingdom · October 2017–October 2021]{.cv-date}

- PhD research on cycling and socioeconomic disadvantage.
- Teaching support in predictive analytics and sustainable spatial planning.

[INTRA Ingeniería de Tráfico]{.cv-institution}\

- Sustainable transport planning.
